scope: Independent frozen-source collector delta and offline counterexample review. No database, provider, key, service, Docker or paid invocation. Local Go serialization bridge and bounded helper tests only.

resolved_prior_findings.evidence: Exact original changed cap/allocation/corpus/task-order input rejected by validate_batch; budget numbers emitted from validated registration.

Exact old incomplete fixture rejected at sealed-source gate. Independent complete positive fixture then wrong GET project, wrong SQL project and both wrong projects rejected; changed CLI body hash/response run/key rejected. Real api.Submit byte bridge matches all four corpus tasks plus five escape/control/Unicode/large-string variants.

findings.description: Provisioner uses shell-quoted client.env values. Collector deliberately reads a plain three-variable file and treats single quotes literally. Quoted tenant fails incomplete client environment before CLI or audit; same synthetic plain values pass. Preserve shell quoting of api/worker/audit DSNs; validate and emit plain safe API/tenant/token values only.

accepted_boundaries: Exact deployment purpose, selected deepseek-v4-flash request alias, $2 and four $0.50 allocations; separate fixed eval-01 output, candidate/corpus/registration hashes and pinned CLI binary.
No automatic new batch or resubmission: --execute uses exclusive directory; --collect uses saved intents/IDs and stops at missing/unknown run; audit/CLI error stops further submissions.

Explicit private schema/OID/current+session audit role and read-only/no-DML/nonowner proof; SQL business relations qualified with psql identifier variables; minimal environment excludes inherited provider/PG routing variables.
Missing/duplicate/orphan reservations and wrong credential group/pricing fail auditing; unknown reserves remain exposure, invoice remains unverified.

Native response artifacts are downloaded and SHA256-checked; request model remains an alias. Collector does not turn native model observations into a pinned-server-version claim or extract a new top-level returned-model summary.

Receipt request bytes match current generated Submit struct and actual CLI scope/hash algorithm for tested fixed-corpus inputs. --submit-json is a local serialization test bridge, not a request validator or dispatch path.
limits: No actual PostgreSQL ACL/RLS/schema-OID/transaction test was run; audit SQL is source-reviewed and subprocess fixtures are mocked. Prior schema-USAGE hypothesis is not independently confirmed as a defect.
Local signed-off descriptors and file hashes do not attest live worker configuration or process identity; launcher still must enforce actual version/config/authority and quiescence gates.
Fixed directory and four caps are one collector batch policy, not a perpetual authorization or provider invoice limit. No paid evidence.
This delta review does not implement the larger design wish list (cross-schema global inventory, lifecycle cleanup or deployment launcher).
